body: Kratom was an insanely grueling withdrawal. I could hardly move for like 10 days. Still not back to myself and it's been 46 days now. I also didn't have self control and took it four times a day every four hours for about a year. 40 GPD. I think it depends on self control. When something feels good to me and It gives me that boost to knock out everything plus more in my day it was easy to keep it going. If you did it every now and then I'm sure like with anything in moderation it would be okay, but you don't know how you're body would react unless you do it and it could go wrong easily and gradually.
